title: Clients
description: Clients and companies for the "Worked with" strip (PRD FR-51, FR-52). An empty list is valid: the strip is then omitted.

name.description: Display name; also the logo's alt text.

website.description: Optional; without it the logo is not a link.

logo.description: Logo file relative to src/assets, e.g. clients/simple-finance.png.

plate.description: Plate the logo sits on so it stays visible in both themes (dark for white artwork).

ratio.description: Logo width ÷ height, to reserve space without layout shift.

source.description: Where the logo was originally taken from (provenance).
